name: Hidden Treasures
label: Quest
description: Hidden Treasures: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Daddy told me to give you this key. He said it opens a chest out back behind the house.
He also wanted me to thank you. Did you do a favor for him? Did you tell him you found my doll?
Well here's the key. And thank you friend. Thank you! You're a very nice friend!

clips.title: Progress
paras: This chest is old and covered in grime.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The key fits the lock, and the chest opens...
